title: polystichum carvifolium
intro: Polystichum carvifolium, commonly known as the leathery fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum carvifolium include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress and anxiety relief. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
